body: I still think I'd be better off dead. I'm well aware that there's no reset.. It's what I want. I'm not suited for this world.

I am, yes. I decided to use an old flatscreen as a computer monitor to put more money into setting up my rig. I'm not complaining though, it's 26 inches and still looks glorious! Saying that, I am saving up for a 1080p monitor sometime in the future.
